stops.name: Njupeskär
stops.detail: In addition, Sweden's highest waterfall, the 93-meter-high Njupeskär, is located in the national park.

stops.name: Kungsleden
stops.detail: 140 km of marked hiking trails lead through the park, including the southern section of the Kungsleden, Sweden's most famous long-distance hiking trail.
